target.title: Equivariant stable connectivity for higher-dimensional irreducible representations

positive_partials.statement: L_G E(T) is at least -dim(T)-connective for Nisnevich-connective E and noetherian essentially smooth equivariant T; all zero-dimensional field-orbit values are connective.
positive_partials.scope: Finite tame G over infinite k; ordinary equivariant Nisnevich topology; spectral S1 localization.

positive_partials.statement: Subgroup induction restriction is t-exact and commutes with localization; known subgroup connectivity controls stalks with that set-theoretic stabilizer.
positive_partials.scope: In particular stabilizers 1 and C2 under the known source hypotheses.

positive_partials.statement: All geometrically free equivariant henselian germs are connective after localization over infinite perfect k.
positive_partials.scope: More precisely, free germs with quotient residue separably generated over k; arbitrary imperfect-field free germs are not claimed.

positive_partials.statement: Negative local homotopy sheaves vanish on the punctured standard S3 representation over C.
positive_partials.scope: Every scheme point of every equivariant etale object over the punctured representation, including nonclosed points; germs over the origin remain unresolved; no assertion about arbitrary global section connectivity.

positive_partials.statement: A positive-relative-dimension smooth presentation with support quasi-finite over the base requires a tangent subrepresentation of dimension r with 1<=r<=codimension of support.
positive_partials.scope: Fixed rational point, tame finite group; rank-one obstruction credited to Heller-Voineagu-Ostvaer 2015; not a connectivity counterexample.

unsolved_gap: Detection/effacement at positive-dimensional henselian germs with uncovered nonabelian stabilizers; standard S3 fixed origin remains uncontrolled (only >=-2 bound).
